description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' which displays and manages a list of notes, including fetching data from an API, handling search, pagination, and deletion of notes.

methods.name: NotesList
methods.description: A React functional component displaying a list of notes with search, pagination, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on current page, pageSize, and search parameters.

methods.name: onSubmitSearch
methods.description: Handles the search form submission and updates search parameters.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID after user confirmation and refreshes the notes list.
